scope: Ten distinct creative iteration, comparison handoff, reliability, and interchange improvements in the public tool. Separate private website excluded.

improvements.evidence: TestComparisonCellRecipesReplayPixels: save/load/render every candidate and compare decoded cell pixels.
Fractional coverage, alpha, crop, nonzero origins, mixed axes, cancellation; independent 1500-case rational oracle within one channel level.
Decoded white-matte pixels, nonzero origins, bounded writer, cancellation, catalog discovery and no-clobber publication.
Exact decoded straight 8-bit RGBA, tif aliases, nonzero origins, byte limits, cancellation and PNG-only custom DPI.
TestOptionsRejectExplicitFlagOverlap and TestOptionsComposeWithDistinctExplicitFlags; original overlap behavior fails regressions.
Private and public service tests preserve all indices and earlier artifacts; public regression passed 100 repetitions; old truncated-loop overlay fails.
State, browser and Quint tests preserve accepted settings without reviving invalid preview authority; bad revival mutation fails.
Both axes, rounding, first-use initialization, hidden fields, changed accepted ratio, invalid blanks, mode reentry, unlocked values, host reset and export limits.
Ctrl/Cmd+Enter from custom colors and advanced JSON; invalid, pending and unsupported-host gating.
Actual browser case retains typed custom colors and advanced options when the selected tab is clicked.

independent_review.coordinator_model: fixed by harness; not changed by prompt
independent_review.structure: Three implementation contexts and six independent verification/review contexts; scheduled within three-worker concurrency limit.
independent_review.repair: One repair phase corrected stale docs and the ratio-lock lifecycle defect; independent browser checks confirmed the final fix.

limits: Local macOS arm64 and Chromium evidence; no hosted CI is configured and no all-host or all-platform claim.
Area uses display-space premultiplied-alpha averaging. Independent exact-rational coverage differs by one 8-bit channel level at floating half-rounding in 68 tested pixels; no universal proof.
BMP flattens alpha onto white. TIFF uses uncompressed straight 8-bit RGBA and codec-default 72 DPI. Custom DPI is PNG-only. The 32 MiB artifact limit remains.
Finite models abstract pixels, codecs and UI events; their passing results do not prove a machine-checked refinement.
No native Safari, Firefox, external MCP host, screen-reader, large-scale throughput or release/deployment verification.
